meta.description: Weekly job pipeline + WhatsApp summary notification. After writing all 3 sheets, collects results and sends a top-5 job summary to your WhatsApp via Twilio. SETUP: (1) Google Sheets ID in nodes 5,9,10. (2) OpenAI key in node 7. (3) Google Sheets OAuth credential in nodes 5,9,10. (4) Twilio credential in node 13. (5) Replace YOUR_WHATSAPP_NUMBER in Format WhatsApp Summary node with your number (e.g. 254712345678). (6) Use Twilio sandbox from_number +14155238886 for testing, your Twilio number for production.
